The '''Raid on the Juno convoy''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ambush that occurred on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] group [[Juno (freighter group)|''Juno'']] after the events on [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]].<ref name="X-wing" />
